verdicts.decision_note: The client requests the missing 3D model artifacts and specifies their project-local directory so the integrated-board assets can resolve on another machine.
First concrete portability failure: integrated-board components were absent because their 3D models referenced machine-local libraries.
Distinct Linux and Windows-path failure evidence identifies 12 hard-coded references that prevented most 3D models from loading.
The client establishes project-relative ${KIPRJMOD} model references as the cross-machine KiCad asset configuration; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
The client adds a concrete KiCad-version compatibility constraint by identifying that version-specific third-party path variables fail across KiCad 8 and 9; no prior attribute becomes obsolete.
